command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-matched-r2.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SCRIPT="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/validate_matched_eye_ab.py"
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
test -f "$SCRIPT"; test -f "$SHADOW"
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_matched_frozen_ab_20260912_r2"
rm -rf "$OUT"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$SCRIPT" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9264 --cdp-port 9265 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_matched_frozen_ab_20260912_r2.stdout.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
cat "$OUT/report.json"
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SOURCE_BRANCH=chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912
echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_MATCHED_VIRTUAL_TIME_FROZEN_CANONICAL_EYE_AB_NO_LIVE_WRITE
